name: Adobe Firefly
tagline: Generative AI for images, video, audio and translation
description: Adobe Firefly is Adobe's generative AI service. Its plans are measured in monthly generative credits and cover images, short video, translation, sound effects and music.
strengths: Free daily generations are described on the page
Team plans are priced per licence
limitations: Free daily generation limits are not stated

plans.name: Firefly Standard
highlights: Translate up to 6 minutes of audio/video

plans.name: Firefly Premium
highlights: Unlimited access to the Firefly Video Model

plans.name: Pro / Pro Plus / Premium for teams
plans.note: Team plans are shown as 'Annual, billed monthly' at the same prices as the individual Pro, Pro Plus and Premium plans

free.details: The page describes free daily generations across image, video and audio; daily amounts are not stated.

pricing.trial: A free trial is shown for Standard, Pro and Pro Plus; its length is not stated.
pricing.regional: Prices are shown in US$. No tax or regional note was stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Individuals tab, monthly billing, US$: Standard $9.99, Pro $19.99, Pro Plus $49.99, Premium $199.99; free trial shown on Standard, Pro and Pro Plus. Generative credits per month: 2,000 / 4,000 / 10,000 / 50,000. Free daily generations exist without a plan. Team plans were not re-read.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

keyFeature: Generative AI for images, video, audio and translation

profile.headline: Adobe's creative app for generating and editing images, video, audio and vectors

capabilities.title: Generate images in many styles
capabilities.text: From text, an existing image or a sketch, in styles such as graphic design, drawing, pixel art, anime art and sticker.

capabilities.title: Edit photos with AI
capabilities.text: Remove a background, an object or a person, upscale an image, expand it, or generate a new background.

capabilities.title: Make and translate video
capabilities.text: Generate video from text or an image, create talking avatars and animation, edit and upscale video, and translate it.

capabilities.title: Make audio
capabilities.text: Generate speech and character voices, dub with AI, and generate music and sound effects.

featureCards.name: Firefly Boards
featureCards.text: An infinite-canvas workspace for ideation and collaboration.

featureCards.name: Vision, storyboard and mood boards
featureCards.text: Generate boards to explore a concept.

featureCards.name: Firefly AI Assistant
featureCards.text: Picks the right tool from a description of what you want.

featureCards.name: Firefly Custom Models
featureCards.text: Train a model on your own images (public beta, per the page).

featureCards.name: Partner models
featureCards.text: The page lists models from Adobe, Google, OpenAI, Runway, Kling AI, Luma AI, Topaz and ElevenLabs.

featureCards.name: Mobile apps
featureCards.text: Firefly also runs as a mobile app on iOS and Android.

audienceDetail.text: Brand identity exploration and concept mood boarding.
Photo editing tools such as object removal and upscaling.
B-roll, sound design and translation of finished videos.
Campaign assets and social media content.

scenarios.title: Create campaign assets
scenarios.text: Generate and adapt images for a campaign.

scenarios.title: Make social media content
scenarios.text: Produce graphics and short videos for each platform.

scenarios.title: Add B-roll and sound design
scenarios.text: Generate footage and sound effects to fill gaps in a cut.

gettingStarted.text: Select Create now or Try Firefly now on the page.
Pick what you want to make.

gettingStarted.step: Enter a prompt and pick a model
